name: How long does bathroom finish carpentry typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does bathroom finish carpentry typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of bathroom finish carpentry varies significantly based on the project's scope and complexity. For a small bathroom with a new vanity and basic trim, it might take 1-3 days. A larger or more intricate bathroom involving custom built-ins, extensive trim work, or multiple intricate installations could take 5-10 days or more. Factors such as the availability of materials, custom fabrication requirements, and the specific skills needed for specialized installations also influence the timeline. We provide a detailed project schedule after assessing your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bathroom finish carpentry duration varies, typically 1-3 days for basic projects and 5-10+ days for complex ones, depending on scope and custom work.
